record_title: Automatic continuity for bounded Borel rotation-invariant conic valuations
limitations: The theorem assumes both global boundedness and Borel measurability on polyhedral cones. It does not classify unbounded measurable valuations or prove that boundedness alone forces measurability, is scalar-valued and finite-dimensional, and relies on the recent L1 orthoscheme vanishing theorem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; recent parallel or differently phrased work may remain unindexed.
